overview: A 144-character analysis places plesiopedal Dallasaurus and flipper-limbed hydropedal forms within Mosasauridae; limb grade alone does not define the family or show ancestry.
overviewZh:
沧龙科是生活于海洋的爬行动物，成员的肢体形态并不相同。Bell 与 Polcyn 的 144 性状分析同时纳入步行型肢体较明显的 Dallasaurus 和肢体更呈鳍状的鳍桨型成员；该分析把两种状态都放在沧龙科内。单凭肢体等级不能定义整个科，也不能据此把 Dallasaurus 写成后期成员的直系祖先。

## 食性、觅食和体型证据

五个马斯特里赫特期类群的牙釉质碳同位素支持样本中的海生肉食和资源分化；这组样本不能代表全科统一食谱，也无法完全拆分猎物、潜水和生境的影响。所选研究中的小型形态多为步行型，较大型形态多为鳍桨型；这是研究样本中的适应等级，不是全科精确体型范围。该分析并不显示每种沧龙都占据一个不同生态位。

## 地点和年代只覆盖具名样本

本档案举例的地点包括得州中北部的中土仑期 Dallasaurus 样本，以及马斯特里赫特标准地区最晚马斯特里赫特期的 Mosasaurus hoffmanni 标本。显示的约 9200 万至 6600 万年前范围连接两个局部样本；后一个标本位于当地 K/Pg 界线下方一米以内。它不是沧龙科全球精确的首现、末现或完整分布。

ecology.diet: Mosasaurids were marine carnivores, but their diets were not uniform. Carbon-isotope measurements from tooth enamel in five Maastrichtian taxa support resource partitioning among that sample. The small sample does not establish one family-wide menu or fully separate the effects of prey, diving and habitat.
ecology.habitat: The sampled animals lived in marine settings. Isotope comparisons suggest that foraging differed among the five Maastrichtian taxa, but the signal does not identify a single habitat for every mosasaurid. The Texas and Maastricht localities in this profile are examples, not a map of the family’s full distribution.
ecology.locomotion: The cited analysis compares plesiopedal limbs with the more flipper-shaped hydropedal condition. Its character coding places both within Mosasauridae and supports separate acquisitions of hydropedal limbs in the sampled tree. This is a phylogenetic result, not a simple march from walking to swimming.
ecology.bodySize: In the sampled comparison, smaller forms tend to have plesiopedal limbs and larger forms tend to be hydropedal. These are adaptive grades in the study sample, not a measured size range for every member of Mosasauridae.
ecology.guild: The five-taxon Maastrichtian isotope sample supports resource partitioning among marine carnivores. It does not show that every mosasaurid occupied a distinct niche or reveal the exact diet of each species.
ecology.dietZh: 沧龙科是海生食肉动物，但其食性并不一致。对五个 Maastrichtian 类群牙釉质的碳同位素测量支持该样本中的资源分化。样本量较小，不能据此确定整个科统一的食谱，也无法完全区分猎物、潜水和生境的影响。
ecology.habitatZh: 所取样的动物生活于海洋环境。同位素比较提示，马斯特里赫特期的五个类群觅食方式有所不同，但这些信号无法确定所有沧龙科成员共有的一种生境。本条列出的德克萨斯和马斯特里赫特地点只是实例，并非该科完整分布图。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引分析比较了原始型四肢与更呈鳍状的水生型四肢。其特征编码将两者都置于沧龙科之内，并支持在所取样的系统树中水生型四肢分别演化。这个结果来自系统发育分析，并非从行走到游泳的简单线性演变。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 在所取样的比较中，体型较小者往往具有原始型四肢，体型较大者往往具有水生特化型四肢。这些是该研究样本中呈现的适应等级，并非沧龙科所有成员的实测体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 马斯特里赫特期五个类群的同位素样本支持海洋食肉动物之间存在资源分化。它没有表明每种沧龙科动物都占据不同生态位，也不能揭示每个物种的确切食谱。

traits: The cited phylogenetic analysis places both plesiopedal and hydropedal members within Mosasauridae.
Two incomplete Dallasaurus skeletons preserve cranial, axial and limb characters for the family-level comparison.
The sampled tree places plesiopedal and hydropedal limb conditions in separate lineages; this pattern is not a direct ancestor sequence.
evidenceSummary: Two Dallasaurus skeletons, five isotope-sampled taxa and one younger Mosasaurus specimen frame a sampled ~92–66 Ma envelope, not family-wide age bounds.
evidenceSummaryZh: 两个不完整 Dallasaurus 骨架和 144 性状系统分析提供形态与肢体演化证据；五个类群的同位素样本用于比较特定马斯特里赫特期动物的觅食差异；一件 Mosasaurus hoffmanni 标本提供较晚的出现记录。三种证据各有不同取样范围，合并后的年代外包区间不能当作全球首现或末现。
traitsZh: 所引系统发育分析将原始型四肢和水生型四肢成员都置于沧龙科之内。
两件不完整的 Dallasaurus 骨架保存了头骨、轴骨骼和四肢特征，可用于科级比较。
所取样的系统树将原始型和水生适应型肢体状态分别置于不同谱系；这种模式不是直接的祖先序列。

geography: Late Triassic marine deposits of southwestern China (Odontochelys sample)
Middle Triassic Vellberg deposits, Germany (Pappochelys sample)
overview: Three Odontochelys specimens from southwestern China preserve a developed plastron, expanded ribs and neural plates, but no complete carapace. Pappochelys from Vellberg, Germany, preserves broadened ribs and paired gastralia. These named stem-turtle samples inform comparisons of shell evolution; they do not form a demonstrated ancestor sequence or date the origin of crown turtles.

ecology.diet: The cited shell studies do not establish diet for Testudines.
ecology.habitat: Li et al. interpret the marine deposits that yielded Odontochelys as a marginal sea or river-delta setting. This describes that fossil's depositional context, not turtle habitat as a whole.
ecology.locomotion: The shell studies do not establish a locomotor mode. Ribs, gastralia and shell elements are anatomical evidence, not observations of movement.
ecology.bodySize: The cited shell specimens do not support a body-size estimate for Testudines as a whole.
ecology.guild: The shell anatomy and depositional context do not establish an ecological guild.

traits: Odontochelys preserves a fully developed plastron, expanded ribs and neural plates without a complete carapace
Pappochelys preserves broadened ribs and robust paired gastralia rather than a fused plastron
The shell sequence is a comparative homology model across named samples, not direct ancestry
evidenceSummary: Li et al. describe three Odontochelys specimens from southwestern China; Schoch and Sues describe Pappochelys from Vellberg. The comparison informs shell-evolution hypotheses, while each specimen and the published analyses retain their own limits.

title.zh: 两种标本各自记录了甲壳的不同构造

text.en: Odontochelys and Pappochelys preserve different combinations of ribs and shell bones. Researchers compare those named fossils to test how the turtle shell assembled. Their positions in a comparison do not show that one was the direct ancestor of the other, and neither fossil sets the date when crown turtles first appeared.
text.zh: Odontochelys 与 Pappochelys 保存了不同组合的肋骨和甲壳骨。研究者把这两件具名化石放在一起比较，以检验龟壳如何形成。比较中的位置不能证明一者是另一者的直系祖先，两种化石也不能确定冠群龟类首次出现的时间。

ecology.diet: No taxon-wide diet is established by the cited skull and skeleton studies; this field remains unresolved.
ecology.habitat: The cited studies document fossil localities and anatomy but do not establish a single habitat for Lepidosauria; no broader habitat is inferred here.
ecology.locomotion: No taxon-wide locomotor mode is assigned from the CT-resolved skull and skeletal characters.
ecology.bodySize: No taxon-wide body-size estimate is assigned from the single or partial specimens used in the cited analyses.

traits: Megachirella PZO 628 contributes CT-resolved cranial, wrist and shoulder characters to a combined-evidence analysis
Taytalura PVSJ 698 preserves a three-dimensionally exposed skull with CT-resolved early lepidosauromorph characters
Bellairsia NMS G.2022.1.1 was examined with synchrotron tomography and tested as a stem squamate
evidenceSummary: Named specimens and imaging studies support these matrix-dependent positions, not direct ancestors, crown first appearances or global ecological histories.

title.en: Three scans, three places on the lepidosaur tree
title.zh: 三组影像，三种系统树位置

text.en:
Three imaged fossils anchor this route through early lepidosaur history. Megachirella PZO 628 contributes CT-resolved skull, wrist and shoulder characters; Taytalura PVSJ 698 preserves a three-dimensionally exposed skull examined by CT; Bellairsia NMS G.2022.1.1 was studied with synchrotron tomography. These are complementary specimens, not one continuous lineage.

The cited analyses place Megachirella and Bellairsia on the squamate stem and Taytalura among early-diverging stem lepidosauromorphs. A stem placement means a fossil lies on the branch leading toward a living group, outside that group’s crown; it does not identify a direct ancestor. The route records anatomy and matrix-dependent relationships, not a shared diet or habitat for Lepidosauria.
text.zh:
三件经过成像研究的化石构成这条早期鳞龙类路线的支点。Megachirella PZO 628 提供 CT 解析的头骨、腕部和肩部性状；Taytalura PVSJ 698 保存了经 CT 检查的三维暴露头骨；Bellairsia NMS G.2022.1.1 则接受了同步辐射断层扫描研究。这些是互补样本，不是一条连续谱系。

所引分析把 Megachirella 和 Bellairsia 放在有鳞类干群，把 Taytalura 放在早期分出的鳞龙形类干群。干群位置表示化石位于通向现生类群的分支上、但在其冠群之外；这不等于认定直系祖先。这条路线记录的是解剖结构和依赖矩阵的系统关系，并未说明整个鳞龙类具有共同食性或生境。

geography: Middle Turonian Arcadia Park Shale, north-central Texas (Dallasaurus sample)
Maastrichtian type area, the Netherlands (sampled Mosasaurus occurrence)
overview: Mosasauroidea is branch-defined while Mosasauridae is node-defined; Dallasaurus anatomy and isotope studies address separate samples, not all mosasauroids.
overviewZh: Mosasauroidea 按分支定义，Mosasauridae 则围绕共同祖先及其后代定义。两具不完整的 Dallasaurus 骨架和五个马斯特里赫特期分类群的同位素研究回答不同问题，不能代表全部沧龙类。

ecology.diet: Tooth-enamel isotope values, considered alongside body-size estimates, distinguish resource use among five mosasaur taxa from the Maastrichtian type area. This is evidence for partitioning within that sample, not a single diet that can be assigned across Mosasauroidea.
ecology.habitat: The fossils and isotope comparisons come from marine settings: the Dallasaurus material is from middle Turonian north-central Texas, and the feeding comparison is from the Maastrichtian type area in the Netherlands. These local study settings do not map the group's full habitat range.
ecology.locomotion: The two Dallasaurus skeletons retain plesiopedal limbs. In the cited analysis, that limb grade is compared with hydropedal forms; the contrast describes sampled anatomy and does not by itself define family membership.
ecology.bodySize: Size estimates accompany the isotope sample for five named taxa from the Maastrichtian type area. They help interpret those comparisons but do not constitute a size range for Mosasauroidea worldwide.
ecology.guild: The five-taxon comparison supports resource partitioning in one Maastrichtian community. It does not place every mosasauroid in a fixed ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 结合体型估计考察牙釉质同位素值，可区分马斯特里赫特阶模式产地五种沧龙类群的资源利用。这是该批样本中资源分化的证据，不能据此为沧龙超科整体指定单一食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石与同位素比较均来自海相环境：Dallasaurus 材料来自德克萨斯州中北部的中土仑期地层，食性比较则取自荷兰 Maastrichtian 型区。这些局部研究环境不能描绘该类群完整的生境范围。
ecology.locomotionZh: 两具 Dallasaurus 骨架都保留了原始型肢体。在所引分析中，这种肢体等级与水生适应型进行比较；这种差异描述的是样本中的解剖形态，本身不能界定科级归属。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 来自马斯特里赫特阶模式产地的五个具名类群，其同位素样本同时包含体型估计。这些估计有助于解释样本间比较，但不构成沧龙超科在全球范围内的体型区间。
ecology.guildZh: 对五个分类单元的比较支持某个 Maastrichtian 群落中的资源分化；这并不意味着可以为所有沧龙超科成员指定固定的生态类群。

traits: The cited nomenclatural analysis defines Mosasauroidea by a branch and Mosasauridae by a node, so the names need not cover identical sets on every phylogenetic tree.
Two incomplete Dallasaurus skeletons preserve skull and axial anatomy together with plesiopedal limbs, linking the taxon's position to more than isolated teeth.
The analysis compares plesiopedal and hydropedal limb grades as anatomical conditions; it treats those grades separately from the definition of a family.
evidenceSummary: Name definitions, two incomplete Dallasaurus skeletons and isotope data from five Maastrichtian taxa answer separate questions, not universal ecology.
evidenceSummaryZh: 类群定义的区分来自命名学分析；Dallasaurus 解剖和五类群马斯特里赫特期同位素样本回答的是不同问题。生态陈述仅适用于所研究的标本和地点，不据此指定所有沧龙类共有的食性、栖地或生态功能群。

readerLimitations.en: The page combines different evidence: name definitions, two incomplete Dallasaurus skeletons and isotope data from five Maastrichtian taxa. These samples inform specific clade, anatomy and resource-use questions; they do not establish one ecology or body-size range for all mosasauroids.
readerLimitations.zh: 本页并列的是不同证据：名称定义、两具不完整 Dallasaurus 骨架，以及五个马斯特里赫特期分类群的同位素数据。这些样本分别支持分支、解剖和资源利用方面的讨论，不能建立适用于全部沧龙类的统一生态或体型范围。

traitsZh: 所引命名学分析将 Mosasauroidea 定义为一个分支，将 Mosasauridae 定义为一个节点，因此在不同系统发育树上，这两个名称涵盖的类群未必完全相同。
两具不完整的 Dallasaurus 骨架共同保存了头骨、中轴骨骼和原始型四肢，使其系统位置的判断不只依赖孤立牙齿。
分析将原始型和水生特化型四肢等级作为解剖状态进行比较，并将这些等级与科的定义区分开来。
